test_pop_basic: test the DataFrame.pop method to remove a column and return its values
test_pop_non_unique_cols: test the DataFrame.pop method with non-unique column names returning a DataFrame
test_pop_multiindex: test the DataFrame.pop method with MultiIndex columns at different depth levels
test_pop_column_name_preserved: test the DataFrame.pop method preserves column name metadata after removal
test_pop_inplace_caching: test the DataFrame.pop method handles inplace operations without caching issues
